name: proxy-list-recv-unbounded-alloc
title: Proxy LIST/RECV allocate vec![0u8; len] from unbounded wire u32
description: proxy/device_commands/list.rs:60-62 (DENT name_len) and recv.rs:62-63 (FAIL reason length) size allocations from a raw device u32 with no clamp. Clamp to filename/error-sized max or MAX_PAYLOAD before allocating. Finding #7.
creator: magicdian
